card.name: The word rebound in drug effects
card.fires_on: The word "rebound" in drug labels, where it describes a swing back after stopping or changing a drug. It usually follows "risk of", "prevent", or "subsequent" and comes before terms like hypertension or hypoglycemia.

modes.label: Rebound after stopping
modes.description: "Rebound" names an effect that returns after a drug is stopped or reduced, followed by a condition word.

modes.label: Rebound in levels
modes.description: "Rebound" names a rise back in a measured level, such as drug concentration or viral load.
modes.example: Resistance to adefovir dipivoxil can result in viral load<< rebound>> which may result in exacerbation of hepatitis
